name: icon
title: Icon
description: Icon names a lucide-react icon (or any SVG component) for screen readers: <Icon icon={TrashIcon} label="Deleted" /> renders role=img with that label. Decorative icons need no wrapper, since lucide hides them by default.
docs: The registry draws its icons with `lucide-react`: import them by name (`import { CheckIcon } from "lucide-react"`). Lucide sets `aria-hidden` on an icon that has no `aria-*`, `role` or `title` prop, so a decorative icon needs no wrapper. Use `Icon` only when the icon carries meaning nothing else states: `<Icon icon={TriangleExclamationPointIcon} label="Blocked" />` renders `role="img"` with that `aria-label`. Size comes from the parent (Button, Badge, menu items and inputs set `[&_svg]:size-4`) or a `size-*` class: `size-3.5` beside `text-body-sm`, `size-4` beside `text-body`, `size-5` beside a title; our classes override lucide's `size` prop. Colour is `currentColor`: set a text colour, like `text-success`.
